create_union_type: create a discriminated union dataclass using _Union as base class with typed fields
build_union_instance: build a union instance using Union.create with a single keyword argument specifying the active variant
test_union_type_property: test the union type property returns the active variant name as a string
test_union_value_property: test the union value property returns the value of the active variant field
review_union_tag_validation: review _UnionTag.create validates tag names against dataclass field names at equality check time
